mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, suppressing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 0.5% MoM AND RSAFS declines > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% MoM, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO growth > 1.0% monthly), a monthly decline in INDPRO signals an imminent economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% monthly, a decline > 0.5% MoM fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently high unemployment rate (above 7.5%) indicates weak labor market conditions, suppressing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts fall below 800,000 units, it signals a weakening in the housing sector and broader consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 800.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a 'growth vs inflation' trade-off, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines > 0.1% MoM AND CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.1% MoM and CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.2% MoM, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
